note: Preserved prose evidence, NOT recomputed here. The Wave-1 signal-ablation classifiers ran on measured embeddings from five local encoders plus an NLI cross-encoder; those assets are not part of this repository. The ablation in expected/ablation.json mirrors the progression through production bundle APIs on synthetic vectors instead.
experiment: Wave-1 signal ablation (wave1/artifacts/signal-ablation.json): classify correct vs near-wrong hard cases from score-only, geometric, and cross-encoder signals
observation: geometric signals (margin, density, rank, hubness) rescue hard cases the raw score cannot; a generic external verifier adds nothing reliable

mirror.why_score_starts_lower: mirror negatives are adversarially mined for every third anchor, so positives sit between easy and hard negatives in score; the historic mix was less adversarial
mirror.why_stacked_matches: the simulated verifier is right where geometry is confident and coin-flip where it is hard, then joins the probe as one more feature -- redundancy, not harm, exactly the book's 0.900 vs 0.897 shape

sources: book Chapter 15 (geometric bundle lifts hard-case accuracy 0.76 -> 0.90)
